usedFor: HeySummit holds event attendees, and Microsoft Excel records each one with “Add Row To Table” after “New Attendee”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Attendee” in HeySummit, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Each registration becomes a row in an Excel table, so organizers keep a running list.

watchOut: “Add Row To Table” needs an existing Excel table, and “Ticket Purchased” also runs on registration, so pick one trigger.
